name: What permits are required for installing an outdoor linear fire feature in Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for installing an outdoor linear fire feature in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing an outdoor linear fire feature in Pasadena typically requires building permits to ensure compliance with local safety and construction codes. This includes permits for gas line installation and any associated structural work. Specific requirements can vary based on the feature's size, fuel type, and proximity to structures. Our firm handles all necessary permit applications and ensures designs meet local fire safety regulations and zoning ordinances for your specific property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing an outdoor linear fire feature in Pasadena requires building and gas line permits to comply with local safety and construction codes.
